def main():
    # Read two integers from input
    data = input().split()
    x = int(data[0])
    innerVal = int(data[1])
    
    # Print outer x
    print(x)
    
    # Nested block with scoped variable x
    inner_x = innerVal
    print(inner_x)
    
    # Print outer x again (unchanged)
    print(x)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
